_note: Config for expansion 4.1 magnetometry. Paths are specs, never literals. {key, rel} resolves through ek.path_for(key). {exp, rel} resolves inside an expansion folder. Every item marked VERIFY is an assumption written by the build agent on 2026-11-05.

historic_dates.schema: PERMIT_NUM or site_id, easting, northing, source, source_date (YYYY), year_built_max. Independent historic-map dating, from 4.6. VERIFY

confusers_blanks.schema: site_id, kind (confuser|blank), easting, northing, description (culvert, fence, pipe, vehicle, open forest). EPSG:6346. VERIFY

pilot_sites.schema: site_id, stratum, easting, northing, lidar_cx, lidar_cy, why_chosen, PERMIT_NUM (optional). EPSG:6346. Chosen by people, not random. VERIFY

line_data.schema: line_id, time_utc (ISO 8601), easting, northing (EPSG:6346 m), tf_nT (total field), is_repeat (0|1). One file per site. VERIFY against the instrument export

base_station.schema: time_utc (ISO 8601), tf_nT. Same clock as the rover. VERIFY

grid_tif.schema: single band total-field or residual grid in nT, EPSG:6346. Used instead of line data when given

wellheads.schema: site_id, easting, northing, h_acc_m, method (RTK|PPK|autonomous), visible (0|1). EPSG:6346. VERIFY

site_identity.schema: site_id, identity_status (confirmed_well|definite_non_well|ambiguous), casing_evidence (text), non_magnetic_evidence (text). Kept apart from the anomaly outcome. VERIFY

survey._pole_note: Monopole strength p in nT m2 so that B = p / r2. Range assumed for cut casing tops. VERIFY against Hammack et al. (2023) or a measured test casing

processing._igrf_note: Approximate western Pennsylvania main-field angles. VERIFY with IGRF-14 for the survey date
processing._pick_note: 3 sigma is the framework anomaly definition. The two-line support rule and strong_k_sigma are build-agent additions to control false picks
processing._test_object_note: Per site {easting, northing}. A steel object placed at a known position. Set in the site record or here
